Task Orchestrator dispatch rule: every Agent dispatch must pass `model` and `effort` explicitly. The shipped agents use `model: inherit` and carry no `effort`, so omitting them silently runs the subagent on your own model at the model's default effort. This call is missing `model` and `effort`. Retry the same call (keep `subagent_type`, `description`, `prompt`) with `model` and `effort` set. Use the item's dispatch profile `model` and `effort` (from the `advance` result or `items_read` `context`) when it has them. Otherwise use the class of the work in the dispatch policy (`task-orchestrator:model-effort`). Set `mode: off` under `extensions.claude-code.orchestration` in .taskorchestrator/config.yaml to disable this guard.
